fact: In August 2023 the Ministry circulated a drafted National ICT Policy 2023 for stakeholder input, with a Data Governance section (3.2) setting policy statements on data standards, data sharing and a data governance collaboration framework; the data part of a larger policy, so a weak Q1 yes.
title: Drafted National ICT Policy, 2023
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communication and Information Technology (United Republic of Tanzania)
